title: Question 19
passage:
Why did you ask the warehouse to hold both cartons?
A. The customer wants them to arrive together. B. They've already weighed both cartons. C. The shipping labels are on the cartons.

你為什麼請倉庫暫時不要出這兩箱貨？

B. 他們已經量過這兩箱的重量了。
C. 出貨標籤已經貼在箱子上。
